definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that looks impressive, attractive, or admirable. Can refer to physical appearance, behavior, or style. Very common in spoken Japanese.

examples.japanese: その{服|ふく}、{格好|かっこう}いいね。
{彼|かれ}はギターを{弾|ひ}く{姿|すがた}が{格好|かっこう}いい。
examples.english: He looks cool when he plays guitar.

examples.japanese: {格好|かっこう}いいことを{言|い}うだけじゃなくて、{実際|じっさい}に{行動|こうどう}してほしい。
examples.english: I don't just want you to say cool things — I want you to actually take action.

notes:
USAGE:
Often shortened to かっこいい in casual speech and writing. The full form {格好|かっこう}いい is the standard dictionary form. Can describe people, objects, actions, and attitudes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格好|かっこう}いい{人|ひと} (a cool/handsome person)
- {格好|かっこう}いいデザイン (a stylish design)
- {格好|かっこう}よく{見|み}せる (to make something look cool)

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {格好|かっこう}よく
- Negative: {格好|かっこう}よくない
- Past: {格好|かっこう}よかった

SIMILAR WORDS:
- かわいい: cute — focuses on charm and endearment rather than cool impressiveness
- イケメン: good-looking man — specifically for male physical attractiveness
- おしゃれ: fashionable — emphasizes fashion sense specifically

forms.label: Past
forms.negative: {格好|かっこう}よくなかった

forms.label: Conditional ば
forms.negative: {格好|かっこう}よくなければ

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {格好|かっこう}よくなかったら
